title: 📢 New 47-unit apartment building opens on Alsace in West Adams
text:
1 days ago 📢 New 47-unit apartment building finished in West Adams
A new apartment building called 2535 Alsace is now complete at 2535 S. Alsace Ave., just north of Adams Blvd in West Adams .
The project is a six-story, 47-unit complex from CIM Group . It offers a mix of studio and one-bedroom apartments , plus amenities like a rooftop deck . There’s also about 400 square feet of office space on the ground floor.
As part of using development incentives, four apartments are reserved for very low-income households .
CIM has also developed other nearby properties, including 2599 Alsace , and mixed-use buildings at 5109 Adams and 5217 Adams .
If you’re looking to rent in West Adams , this is a new option to keep an eye on, especially if you qualify as very low income and need restricted-rent housing.
